notes:
v0.13.2 Update
- A GM change during a character sheet payment could leave the character's next payment blocked. The wallet now records confirmed payments and declines when another GM takes over.

announcement.title: 📚 GlitchSmith Library v0.13.2
announcement.content: If a GM takes over while a character sheet payment is being processed, the wallet now records whether the payment went through or was declined. The character can make their next purchase, and retrying a completed payment uses the original receipt.
